faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about working with an IT company in Patna.

items.question: What services does Fillip Technologies offer as an IT company in Patna?
items.answer: We cover website development, ecommerce and WordPress, custom software including CRM and ERP, mobile app development for Android and iOS, UI/UX and brand design, SEO and digital marketing, AI automation and chatbots, and IT infrastructure such as networking, servers and security surveillance.

items.question: Where is Fillip Technologies located?
items.answer: Our head office is in Kankarbagh, Patna, Bihar, and we also have a branch office in Ranchi, Jharkhand. Full addresses and phone numbers are listed on our contact page.

items.question: Do you work with small businesses and startups, or only larger companies?
items.answer: Both. We scope projects to the stage a business is at, so a single-page website and a multi-module software platform are both things we take on.

items.question: Can you handle both the website and the software side of a project?
items.answer: Yes. Because web, software, design, marketing and infrastructure sit in the same team, a project that spans several of those areas does not need to be split across vendors.

items.question: Do you only work with businesses in Patna?
items.answer: No. We are based in Patna and work with clients across India and internationally, but being local means businesses in and around Patna can meet us in person.

items.question: What does a project cost and how long does it take?
items.answer: It depends on scope — the number of pages or modules, the features involved, integrations and content requirements. We share a written estimate and timeline after an initial discussion about your requirements.

items.question: Do you provide support after the project goes live?
items.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing maintenance and support covering updates, fixes, performance and security, so you are not left on your own after launch.

items.question: How do I start a project with Fillip Technologies?
items.answer: Get in touch through our contact page or call the numbers listed there. We will talk through your requirement and share a scope and estimate before any work begins.
